results.instruction: Park the vehicle on a level surface, apply the parking brake, and turn on the hazard warning lights.
Place a warning triangle at a safe distance behind the vehicle.
Open the trunk and remove the spare tire, jack, and lug wrench from the storage compartment.
Use the lug wrench to loosen the lug nuts on the wheel that needs to be changed, but do not remove them completely.
Position the jack under the designated jacking point near the wheel to be changed and raise the vehicle until the tire is slightly off the ground.
Fully remove the loosened lug nuts and set them aside in a safe location.
Pull the flat tire straight off the wheel hub and set it aside.
Align the holes of the spare tire with the wheel studs and push it onto the hub.
Hand-tighten the lug nuts onto the wheel studs to secure the spare tire in place.
Lower the vehicle slowly using the jack until the spare tire touches the ground but does not bear the full weight of the car.
Use the lug wrench to tighten the lug nuts in a star pattern to ensure even tightening.
Fully lower the vehicle and remove the jack from under the car.
Perform a final tightening of the lug nuts with the lug wrench to ensure they are secure.
Store the flat tire, jack, and lug wrench back in the trunk.
Check the tire pressure of the spare tire and adjust if necessary, ensuring it is within the recommended range.
Drive cautiously to the nearest service station to have the flat tire repaired or replaced.
